meta.name: ad-library-teardown
meta.description: Use when the user wants to analyze active ads from Meta/Facebook, Google, or LinkedIn ad libraries; tear down a competitor's messaging; extract hooks, offers, CTAs, video transcripts, landing page claims, and test ideas from public ads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解竞品广告,提炼钩子、卖点、CTA 与话术,形成投放测试灵感。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想摸清竞品广告套路并提炼自己的投放创意。
copy.tagline_en: Extract hooks, offers, CTAs, and video angles from public competitor ads.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to reverse-engineer competitor ad messaging before planning your own campaigns.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去 Meta、Google、LinkedIn 的公开广告库查找并分析广告,提炼标题、优惠、视频转录等要点,归纳营销角度并给出测试建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析竞品的活跃广告、搜索 Meta/Google/LinkedIn 的广告库,或提取广告中的标题、优惠、CTA 等细节时触发。

say.text: 看看三星在 Meta 广告库里最近的广告
say.note: Claude 会抓取并拆解其标题、文案和优惠。

say.text: 对比这两家品牌的 Facebook 广告,找出主要差异
say.note: 输出对比表,列出各自的 hooks、CTA 与优惠。

say.text: 把这条视频广告的转录稿拆解一下,提炼 hook
say.note: Claude 会获取转录并总结钩子和最佳引用。

howto.what_en: Claude searches public ads in Meta, Google, and LinkedIn ad libraries, extracts hooks, offers, CTAs, and other elements, groups the competitor's angles, and suggests test ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to analyze a competitor's active ads, search ad libraries on Meta, Google, or LinkedIn, or pull out hooks, offers, CTAs, and similar ad details.

say_en.text: Look at Samsung's recent ads in Meta's ad library.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and break down its headlines, copy, and offers.

say_en.text: Compare the Facebook ads of these two brands and highlight key differences.
say_en.note: Output a comparison table with their hooks, CTAs, and offers.

say_en.text: Break down this video ad's transcript and pull out the hook.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the transcript and summarize the hook and best quote.
